sources.snippet: Taxi-v4 is a reinforcement learning model hosted on Hugging Face under the Hoaichu/Taxi-v4 repository. The supplied page describes it as a “Reinforcement Learning model” and indicates that developers can download it, explore its files, and run it on Hugging Face.
